Carpio Media creates visual work that makes a property, brand, or event feel impossible to ignore. This gallery brings together aerial drone footage, FPV fly throughs, real estate visuals, broadcast work, and branded content produced across New York and beyond.

Based in Forest Hills, Queens, we work with real estate professionals, brands, agencies, production teams, and local organizations that want more than a basic camera angle. Every project begins with clear goals, thoughtful planning, and a creative approach shaped around the people who need to see the finished work.

Our team combines professional photography, cinematic video, FAA compliant drone operations, and precise FPV flying to show location, movement, scale, and atmosphere. From a luxury listing to a live production, the right visual can give people a reason to stop, look closer, and take the next step.
If this is the kind of work you want for your next project, let’s talk. Carpio Media serves Queens, New York City, Long Island, Westchester, New Jersey, and Connecticut.
